description: This file defines the 'Section' class within the MigraDoc Document Object Model. The class represents a document section with headers, footers, page setup, and content elements, providing methods to manipulate and serialize section data in a document.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents a section within a document, containing headers, footers, page setup, and content elements, with methods for manipulation and serialization.

classes.name: Section.SectionValues
classes.description: Encapsulates internal nullable property values for the 'Section' class, including page setup, headers, footers, elements, and comment.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the section object.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy logic for the section, cloning nested objects and setting parent references.

methods.name: PreviousSection
methods.description: Returns the preceding section in the parent collection, or null if none exists.

methods.name: AddParagraph
methods.description: Adds a new paragraph to the section, optionally with specified text and style.

methods.name: AddChart
methods.description: Adds a chart of specified type or default to the section.

methods.name: AddTable
methods.description: Adds a table to the section.

methods.name: AddPageBreak
methods.description: Inserts a page break into the section.

methods.name: AddImage
methods.description: Adds an image from a filename to the section.

methods.name: AddTextFrame
methods.description: Creates a new text frame in the section.

methods.name: LastParagraph
methods.description: Retrieves the last paragraph in the section, or null if none.

methods.name: LastTable
methods.description: Retrieves the last table in the section, or null if none.
